description: One work in the shared bibliography (shared/works.json). A work is the citable unit: a book, treatise, letter, sermon, or article. See RESEARCH-STANDARDS.md sections 3, 4 and 5.

authorIds.description: Author id(s) from shared/authors.json. Empty until verified. Disputed authorship must be flagged in notes and in disputedAuthorship — never silently attributed.

dateWritten.description: When the work was written — never the author's birth/death dates (standards section 5). Null until researched.

disputedAuthorship.description: True when authorship is disputed, uncertain, or the work is pseudonymous. Must be explained in notes.

edition.description: Edition used: editor, series, edition number, year.

editor.description: Editor of the edition cited, where relevant.

id.description: Stable slug: author slug + short work slug, e.g. justin-martyr-first-apology. Lowercase kebab-case.

locator.description: Where a reader can find the work.

url.description: URL to a public-domain source where available, e.g. CCEL / New Advent.

notes.description: Researcher notes, including any authorship dispute. Never a substitute for a verified field.

originalLanguage.description: Original language of the work, e.g. Greek, Latin.

publicDomainStatus.description: Public-domain status of the edition/translation cited. Null/unknown until checked.

publicationInfo.description: Publication info for the edition cited: publisher, place, year.

shortTitle.description: Short display title, if one is used. Labelled as a display convenience, not the work's title.

status.description: Lifecycle status, see RESEARCH-STANDARDS.md section 9. A stub is status not-started.

title.description: Title of the work in the edition cited. Null until verified; do not invent a short title and present it as the work's title.

translator.description: Translator of the edition/translation cited, where relevant.

verificationRecordIds.description: Ids of verification records covering claims in this work entry.
